SQLite 3.54.1 source distribution
Official project: https://www.sqlite.org/
Source and licensing: https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html

The upstream source headers dedicate this code to the public domain and retain the authors' original
notices. Those headers remain unchanged in sqlite3.c and sqlite3.h. Lobo's adapter and build profile are
separate code. This distribution is not an SQLite endorsement or a claim that the complete upstream test
suite was executed. Exact source archive and file digests are in provenance.json.
